title: Do Clinician-Scored Examples Help LLMs Code ADOS-2 from Hour-Long Transcripts?
abstract: arXiv:2611.32050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can apply a written rubric to a transcript, making automated coding of the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS-2) look within reach. A common way to align such a rater with clinicians is to show it expert-scored examples, but whether correct labels improve agreement is rarely tested. We test this for eight speech-based items of hour-long ADOS-2 Module 3 sessions from 48 children, with one local model and a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design. We compare few-shot scoring, an anchored comparison in which the model only judges a child better, similar or worse than scored anchors and a fixed rule gives the score, post-hoc calibration, protocol-based evidence routing and direct scoring of the full transcript. translated_title: 临床医生评分的示例能帮助大语言模型从长达一小时的转录文本中对ADOS-2进行编码吗？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可以将书面评分标准应用于转录文本，这使得对自闭症诊断观察量表（ADOS-2）进行自动化编码看起来触手可及。让此类评分器与临床医生对齐的一种常见方法是向其展示专家评分过的示例，但正确的标签是否能提高一致性却很少被检验。我们使用一个本地模型和预注册的、安慰剂对照的设计，针对48名儿童长达一小时的ADOS-2模块3会话中的八个基于言语的项目进行了测试。我们比较了少样本评分、锚定比较（即模型仅判断某儿童比已评分的锚点更好、相似或更差，再由固定规则给出分数）、事后校准、基于协议的证据路由以及对完整转录文本的直接评分。在40名留出测试儿童上，与临床医生的一致性较为有限，二次加权kappa值介于0.22到0.30之间。将每个示例的标签替换为错误的标签，会改变大约三分之一的少样本评分结果（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本研究通过预注册的安慰剂对照实验首次系统检验了专家评分示例对大语言模型编码ADOS-2的作用，发现正确标签带来的增益有限，模型与临床医生的一致性仍然较低（二次加权kappa仅0.22–0.30）。
en_tdlr: Using a pre-registered, placebo-controlled design, this study shows that expert-scored examples offer limited benefit for LLM-based ADOS-2 coding from hour-long transcripts, with only modest agreement with clinicians (quadratic weighted kappa 0.22–0.30).
